sourceProject: cc_playable_framework / AOE and Combat Magic VFX ports

meaning.automatic: Generic porter binds the shared contract when its exact source conditions are supported; inspect the generated prefab and preview.
meaning.conditional: Shared implementation exists; a new port must bind it from source evidence and pass its own oracle.
meaning.recipe: A source-grounded example exists, but source-specific behavior is not a generic automatic binding. A new port must implement or explicitly defer it.

fixes.acceptance: Native BakeMesh alignment and pivot, rotated parent, two preview viewports. Rotation over lifetime: native rotation3D and baked vertices, start-of-step curve age, and a parent-axis Y spin (VerticalGlow) in preview. Mesh pivot in mesh-bounds units, Mesh World/Velocity alignment and View billboard pivot against native BakeMesh; arrow directions of a Velocity-aligned ring and a pivot-offset glow in preview.

Supported Low/Medium/High quality and velocity closure, native field holdouts and lattice, rotationAmount per axis, matched trajectories and spatial bands. Unsupported module combinations remain high.
Fresh project without AOE controller, AssetDB registered Component and runtime smoke test.
Verify native/imported UV reflection and per-renderer material variants; compare source phases and tight visible ROI.
Source frame, native paths and repeated loop/viewport occupancy. With a source Limit Velocity: native composition cases and matched-birth trajectories of the ported emitter.
World simulation under rotated/scaled parent; matched births and trail growth.
Native burst positions and forward direction across two viewports.
Source ShaderLab math, Unity and browser tight ROI. Vendor-specific shader remains source dependent.

Native flip thresholds (Euclidean or view-axis distance of the particle AABB center plus fudge), layer/order/queue precedence and in-renderer sortMode; preview overlapping sub-renderers of one effect at two viewports.
RenderMode None retains enabled trails; visible pixels and no stray particles.
Native trail age/width/UV samples, two preview times and bounded visible pixels.
Native sampler/mip and GPU texture readback before color compensation.
Actual RGBA16F attachment and FLOAT readback, gradient edge ROI at source and portrait viewport.
First birth rotation/size/color, no giant mesh or flash before first simulation update.
Synchronous child/grandchild births preserve parent center, child inheritance, count and random draw order across repeated bursts.
Source parent emission, child probability, overlap and runtime pool allocation/drop counters.

Repeating bursts follow native Unity per-step emission (fixtures/burst-cycles.json from fixtures/capture-burst-cycles.cs): at most one cycle per 1/60 s of the step, the other due cycles dropped, the burst still ending at its authored time; no Cocos stall when the interval is shorter than a frame. Sub-emitter instances apply the same rule. Per-system counts must match ReferenceCapture systems[] (Hovl Magic circle 3 Fire 164, not 271).
Capture last integration step, exact death count/position and sub-emitter ordering before installing the shared terminal-step burst.
Native BakeMesh and URP render widths in landscape and portrait; portrait preview of a clamped effect with a tight ROI.
Native Horizontal/Vertical BakeMesh extents and the projected ground-ring bbox at two preview times.
Unity burst positions for open/closed arcs with replay, and angular occupancy of a real burst in preview.

Native speed sequences at 60 and 30 fps (magnitude, zero limit, separate axes), native stored/animated/total velocity with linear, orbital, radial and Noise contributions, and radial spread of damped bursts in preview.
Native prewarmed particle ages at start and after the first frame for short and long cycles, and first-frame particle counts in preview.

Unity-imported vs Cocos-imported vertices of every FBX mesh in scope (fixtures/model-import-basis.json: cocos = (-x, y, z) / globalScale), exact sub-mesh per Unity mesh file ID, and upright Mesh-mode particles in preview against the Unity reference.

Per-frame particle counts of the colliding system and its Collision sub-emitters against Unity Play Mode (ReferenceCapture systems[]), with collisions landing on ported colliders in preview; Planes, 2D mode and collision messages stay high.

Birth radius quantiles within 0.02 of Unity for Circle, Cone Base/Volume, Sphere and Hemisphere with full and partial thickness (fixtures/shape-distribution-native.json), plus in-view camera-depth histogram of a wide emitter against Unity Play Mode.

Birth/Death sub-emitters replay the sub system's authored bursts, repeat cycles, rate and duration once per parent event (birth instances follow and end with the parent); per-system particle counts match Unity Play Mode at a fixed frame (Hovl Magic shield 3: Glow/Stovb = parent count, not a fixed 36/s per parent).

Custom1 curves for exactly the renderer-streamed components (m_VertexStreams kept as hex) reach the material per particle age; the material reads customDataTexture under UNITY_PARTICLE_CUSTOM_DATA. Shader-specific use of Custom1 (Hovl center glow, Lightning reveal/edge) still needs a Unity reference at a fixed frame.

Mesh particles with ShapeModule.alignToDirection match native Unity rotation3D within 0.05 deg for circle, rotated circle, 3D start rotation, cone and sphere (fixtures/align-to-direction.json); billboard and world-space variants stay reported until measured.

Source TimeManager maximum particle timestep, AssetDB bound adapter, long-frame emission and full elapsed simulation, replay; looping boundaries/bursts and visual fidelity require additional native acceptance.
Actual camera/node masks, exclusive capture layer, intended preceding-transparent inclusion and distortion exclusion, material-instance capture binding and matching native canvas dimensions.

Native BakeMesh four UV corners for View/World/Local 3D births and Euler spin, rotated camera/emitter, axial rotation before anisotropic size. Vertical pitched/yawed camera remains blocking. Bind the adapter and remeasure the new source pack in Preview.

One isolated Preview target, independent case setup, declared runtime evidence, exact canvas/PNG viewport and screenshot SHA256; failure on evaluation/runtime/console errors. Native frame zero follows the first tick; live gameplay and statistical visual acceptance remain required.

Native BakeMesh extents for billboard/mesh, 2D/3D start size and size-over-lifetime composition across repeated steps. Current-size API omits Noise scaling; bind original source contract and measure spatial and foreground visual parity.

Native View/Stretch playback BakeMesh, path-distance width/gradient/UV, camera plane and endpoint lifetime retention. Bind actual AssetDB script/material IDs with a colored mesh shader and compare each new source in both viewports.

Bind the measured World-space two-constant contract with randomized:false. Native original and held-out high/wrapping seed XYZ trajectories, source Z reflection, pool-order independence and staggered births pass. Local/curve Force and full effect visual parity require separate native and Preview evidence.

Native 1248 frozen-sphere interior contacts, original near-XZ mesh residuals, static axis-aligned uniform scales. Use backend Stay transitions, not timed impact injection. Off-plane/border handling is backend-owned; verify actual new source contact poses and expiry in Preview.

312 native cases bind the strength RNG and scalar/3D size flag across all qualities and held-out wrapping seeds. Random two-curve, amount/scroll and remap remain unsupported; verify source bindings and rendered Preview phases independently.

Require Application.isPlaying in native RNG captures. Gameplay uses ONE XYZ pass per four-lane block; old Edit Mode two-pass data is invalid for runtime. Includes guarded 196 random trajectories, 12 death/retained-slot/late-birth cases and independent automatic PostLateUpdate capture without Simulate. Target pool/trail expiry and full visual parity are separate gates.

Continuous constant-rate Loop Edge restores native X extent, +Y direction and radius-independent speed. 8192 native jitter offsets cover sphere surface before scale. Exact float wrap endpoints, RNG identity, burst/distance/prewarm and full visual parity remain unaccepted; require live imported adapter gates.

816 native births (544 held-out automatic) verify independent lifetime, size, rotation, color and speed; 272 endpoint samples verify lifetime clamp. Preserve stock module seed and store full uint32 in unityNativeSeed. Replay, legacy delegation and live adapter-count gates required. Shape/continuous-batch RNG identity, unsupported initialization modes and full rendered parity remain separate gates.

90 native ForwardBase/ForwardAdd uniform cases cover Auto point lights at pixelLightCount=4. Importance uses gamma luminance .3R+.59G+.11B and attenuation 1/(1+25*d2/r2). Pixel/vertex overlap uses neighboring score differences, not a fixed 3+4 split. Weighted linear RGB tolerance 1e-5 for near ties. Packed overflow SH starts at ranked index8; 204 valid native rows cover RGB/intensity, bounds/range, directions and zero distance. Use normalized Lambert L2 (16/17), clamp distance squared to bounds radius squared, and scale by min(1,rangeSquared/boundsRadiusSquared). Small-plane bounds rows lacking shader pixel coverage are excluded; direction probes independently cover small bounds. Dynamic particle bounds, mixed overflow ordering, other quality budgets/modes, spots and full rendered acceptance remain separate gates; this is a kernel, not automatic wiring.
Reject orphan properties per selected pass and publish complete assets idempotently. Live AssetDB compile is required; import UUID failures may be secondary to EFX3302.
Cross-stage uniform precision must agree for WebGL linking. Import success is not GPU runtime acceptance.

Refresh CPU World/Local module frames and measured Hierarchy transforms before simulation. Reject singular and unsupported spaces; verify downward matched-seed world displacement, not screen direction.
Seven semantic adapters require executeInEditMode/playOnFocus and existing execution order. Probe installed markers after class compilation; passing browser Preview cannot establish Editor behavior.
Use retained native birth seed and measured rotation RNG; preserve TwoConstants endpoint order after reflection. TwoCurves and unbound particles remain unsupported for exact random parity.
Local Sphere Mesh with Euler module only: capture direction before zero speed and add native Euler alignment. Other spaces, shape jitter RNG and full visual parity remain unverified.
Native procedural bounds can be independent of random live-particle AABB. Verify supported Local/Hierarchy subset, reflection and GrabPass sorting; unsupported Noise/motion retains evidence gaps.

Identify GraphicsSettings.currentRenderPipeline; preserve working URP materials. Bind source quality and chosen material baseline. Legacy tint and soft-additive equations differ from migrated URP white additive.
After lost Play Mode RPC acknowledgement, accept only the matching requestId manifest. Preserve busy captures; resume only hash-validated cases, not an assumed completed catalog.
Independent four-lane automatic Circle/Cone/Sphere streams. Sphere volume radius remains a bounded cbrt approximation; manual Emit, alignment and jitter do not inherit exact RNG acceptance.
Linear color space does not imply linear light intensity. Bind GraphicsSettings.lightsUseLinearIntensity and validate source particle light uploads; do not assume intensity and sRGB decoding commute.

Inventory representatives before bulk conversion; report renderer plus module gaps. New particle registries request catalog scope by default. Every declared prefab/phase requires native reference, semantic checks and explicit color/silhouette bounds. Reference selection, Editor lifecycle and trustworthy source producers remain separate required evidence.
Unity oracle fragment samples within 2/255 and per-effect foreground colour inside the Unity seed range (vertex-colour colour space, premultiply, lit particles).
Moving emitter at constant speed: particle count, ages (1/(rate*speed) steps) and path positions equal a Unity per-frame Simulate dump.
Per-system counts and sub-emitter particle centroid/spread match a Unity seeded capture; the FromTo(parent forward, velocity) alignment is only validated within 20 deg (porter flags larger offsets).

Only when the native Edge adapter rejects the system (rate over distance, non-Loop radius): per-particle Unity dump of the moving single-sided Edge emitter shows spread along shape X within +/-radius and start velocity along shape +Y.
Procedural bounds with constant gravity and hemisphere speed: Unity renderer bounds center within 2e-3 (Tanks! PowerUpEffect/Trails) and multi-system draw order inside the Unity seed range.
